audit: innerHTML interpolation ledger — SWS-REM-DIR-20260828 R2 B2-4 (M-3)
policy: Scope = every innerHTML/outerHTML assignment (including +=) and insertAdjacentHTML/document.write call in each --file, walked through callbacks, PLUS construction_fragments. Classifier requires the WHOLE interpolation to be esc(...)/escapeHtml(...), a numeric literal, or ident.length — prefixes/suffixes are MUST-JUSTIFY. Explicit files — no globs. Limitations: no dataflow, no el['innerHTML'], no createContextualFragment.
